title: Growing trust need not be hurried

captions.physics: Helping through experience and attentive clarification
captions.emotions: Feeling a pause before new understanding

meaning: Your thoughtful involvement can support trust when a wish to encourage growth allows a pause and independent understanding.
text: Care can be fruitful even when the response to it is not yet visible. In the physical position of Anahata, the Hermit appears in help through experience, thoughtful clarification and respect for independent understanding. The Empress in energy brings a wish to create warm conditions in which something can develop. The Hanged Man in emotions offers a pause and a changed perspective. Tenderness may be felt when you are not required to open up immediately or demonstrate a result, and there is time to become familiar with the support being offered.

Imagine that one person tries embroidery for the first time using the other’s materials. The more experienced person demonstrates a few stitches and helps choose comfortable fabric. After an initial attempt, there is a wish simply to put the work aside and look again later. **Providing conditions does not require immediate continuation.** The embroidery can stay on its own shelf: care has already appeared in accessible knowledge and a place where a trial is not judged by speed.

A wish to nurture something good can conceal an expectation of grateful enthusiasm. A pause then seems to reject all the help, and experience becomes an argument for continuing. Yet silent waiting can also leave both people uncertain. Warmth benefits from being able to say that time or another approach is needed. Involvement keeps its value when new understanding takes a while.
